title: Coarse and Fine-Grained Hostility Detection in Hindi Posts using Fine Tuned Multilingual Embeddings
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of classifying hostile content (fake news, hate speech, offensive, defamation) in Hindi social media posts. While hate speech is defined in the context of targeting groups based on religious beliefs, the paper does not evaluate religious systems, theological knowledge, or ethical frameworks in the models themselves.
